name: First $1,000 of side income
summary: Work toward a first $1,000 from a side offer by shaping one offer, asking your first 10 people and setting weekly targets.

onboarding.prompt: What skill or idea do you want to offer?
onboarding.reaction: Love it. Let's turn that into one clear offer.

onboarding.prompt: Hours a week you can give it?
onboarding.reaction: Five focused hours goes a long way.

onboarding.prompt: When would you like to reach the first $1,000?
onboarding.reaction: Deadline set. Weekly targets come next.

onboarding.prompt: Do you know people who might want it?
options: Yes, a few names come to mind
onboarding.reaction: Great. Your first 10 are closer than you think.

onboarding.prompt: Have you checked your job contract and local rules for side work?
onboarding.reaction: Worth a look before you start.

phases.name: Shape the offer
actions: Pick a simple way to get paid
Check job contract and local rules

phases.name: Ask
actions: Two to three asks a week

plan_blueprint.calendar: Work blocks on the chosen slots, weekly ask targets, a follow-up reminder for each ask, and a weekly review.

approach_variants.habit: Same two work blocks a week; streak of weeks with asks made.
approach_variants.willpower: Weekly ask challenge and a countdown to the deadline.
approach_variants.time: Every ask, follow-up and delivery is a calendar block; weekly hours review.
approach_variants.reward: Owner-chosen reward at first sale and at the $1,000 mark.
approach_variants.resource: First week gathers tools: payment method, simple sample, and a list of contacts.

guardrails: This plan is general education, not financial advice. Check big decisions with a qualified professional.
Results depend on your offer, effort and market; this plan sets targets, not outcomes.
Check your employment contract, tax rules and any licenses your offer needs.
Every plan item can be edited, moved or removed, and you can add your own steps.
restart_rules: A week with no asks rolls its target into the next two weeks. After two quiet weeks, the plan offers a smaller weekly target or a reshaped offer.
addon_tracks: Suggested: Offer Factory First Offer Kit

price_log.basis: Launch proposal per docs/MARKETPLACE.md; pending owner approval
